title: Zhihe (Bob) Zhao
summary: Founder and CEO of AxiomsTen, building Spiro. Personal AI, long-term memory, and intelligent systems. PhD, CUHK 2025.
content: Zhihe (Bob) Zhao is the founder and CEO of AxiomsTen, building Spiro. His current work explores personal AI, long-term memory, and context-aware agents. He graduated with a PhD from CUHK in 2025.
